name: Venerable Staffcentre
description: Hold the staff level before the hips like a basin's rim, the first stance every student of the school learns.

name: Roundstaff Decree
description: Pour the staff forward in a jab and draw it back to the rim, never leaving the line.

name: Sacrosanct Balancenode
description: Turn a blow aside with a shallow sweep of the shaft, as water spills over a basin's lip.

name: Vigor Sweepstep
description: Settle each step level and slow so that the staff and body keep a single surface, however the opponent moves.

name: Tipcapverdict
description: Raise the guard steadily like a filling basin, then spill it over in a downward strike to the shoulder.

name: Clamping Leftgrip
description: Let the staff overflow across the opponent's weapon and hold it against their body like water against a wall.

name: Whitewood Edict
description: Draw the whole body's weight into one deep thrust that fills the opponent's guard to breaking.

name: Thunderous Bostip
description: Sweep the staff in a broad circle and send a wave of qi spilling across the ground around the user.

name: Radiance Rightgrip
description: Take a strike on the still-held staff and return its full weight in one pouring blow.

name: Noble Volition Tipjab
description: Raise the staff slowly and let the whole stance's accumulated weight pour down upon the opponent's guard, pinning it.

name: Unyielding Tipcap
description: Stand with the staff held high and the eyes on the whole of the opponent's stance, as a hawk watches the field.

name: Quenched Block
description: Jab along the opponent's flank where the river would bend, striking the side they are turned from.

name: Palltipcap
description: Spread the staff above the shoulders like a hawk's wing and let a falling strike glance away.

name: Gliding Spinbreak
description: Walk a slow curving path toward the opponent, never straight, the staff following the bend.

name: Reminiscence Rightgrip
description: Fix the tip on the opening in the opponent's guard and read its width before committing the stroke.

name: Squallblock
description: Bend the line of advance round a parry and strike from the side the parry cannot reach.

name: Thrall Roundstaff
description: Wind the staff around the opponent's weapon like a river bend and carry it off its line.

name: Bogripbanner
description: Rise at the bend and fall through the guard on the line the river has left unwatched.

name: Tenet Bogrip
description: Sweep along one bank and then the other in turn, closing the opponent between the two.

name: Commanding Tipcap
description: Cast the staff's shadow high so the opponent looks up, then strike low along the river.

name: Vacuum Roll
description: Rise like a hawk and stoop with the staff, then turn the stroke round the guard like a river bend.

name: Warding Bogrip
description: Stand with the staff's two ends as the two courts of one house, one to guard and one to act.

name: Steelpivot
description: Jab first from the left end and then from the right in quick succession, never twice from the same side.

name: Unwavering Staffcentre
description: Meet a heavy blow with both ends of the staff in matching positions, spreading the shock.

name: Squall Balancenode
description: Pivot on one foot so the two ends of the staff exchange their places in a single turn.

name: Faithful Whitewood
description: Swing the staff open like a courtyard door to let a blow pass, then close it on the attacker's wrist.

name: Illustrious Block
description: Answer the opponent's stroke on one side with an equal stroke on the other, in the same beat.

name: Taperend Reliquary
description: Hold the opponent's weapon between both ends of the staff so that it can neither advance nor retreat.

name: Volition Pivot
description: Chain four strokes, alternating the staff's ends, so each follows the other's recoil without pause.

name: Bedrock Leftgrip
description: Press the opponent with both ends in turn, qi building until the matched pressure forces them back.

name: Pealroll
description: Split the opponent's guard between the two ends of the staff and strike through the gap.

name: Imperial Roll
description: Bring the staff's two ends together in a single point through the centre of the opponent's guard.

name: Pulsar Tipjab
description: Strike from both courts at once, the paired strokes meeting and pinning the guard in the same moment.

name: Tipcappledge
description: Stand with the staff laid along both arms like two tracks, the guard track in front and the strike track behind.

name: Vacuum Spinbreak
description: Lunge along the strike track while the guard track holds the line of the body.

name: Pall Taperend
description: Swing the staff on the guard track to turn a great stroke off the body and past the shoulder.

name: Vigor Bostip
description: Change tracks with one pace, the guard becoming the strike and the strike becoming the guard.

name: Squall Roll
description: Cut along both lanes of the opponent's guard at once, the staff's ends moving on separate lines.

name: Tipcapvow
description: Lay the staff parallel to the opponent's weapon and press until it cannot leave its line.

name: Statute Bostip
description: Rush down both tracks together, the staff giving the opponent no lane to retreat along.

name: Inviolate Balancenode
description: Reverse the roles of both tracks at the instant of contact, turning the guard into the stroke.

name: Tipcapedict
description: Bring both lanes of the staff's stroke to a single point, shattering the opponent's guard at that seam.

name: Paramount Quenched Staffcentre
description: Join the guard and strike tracks into one stroke that shields the body as it pierces the guard.

name: Prismtipcap
description: Stand with a qi field lit at each end of the staff, two fields held in balance across the body.

name: Haemalblock
description: Rap the opponent's nearest joint with the near end, its field adding a small sting to the touch.

name: Roundstaff Reliquary
description: Reach out with the far end's field and turn a distant blow before it has crossed half its path.

name: Deluge Tipcap
description: Slide forward so that the two fields link along the shaft, forming one band of qi from end to end.

name: Paramount Sweepstep
description: Cut with one field while the other presses the guard, pinching a weapon between the two.

name: Bostipvow
description: Hold both fields against the opponent's arms and draw them toward each other.

name: Vacuumblock
description: Bridge the two fields at the tip and thrust through the narrow gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Unrivaled Bogrip
description: Sweep the staff round with both fields trailing, striking all who stand within the ring they draw.

name: Venombogrip
description: Reverse the pull of the two fields at the point of contact so the opponent's own force turns against them.

name: Prism Sweepstep
description: Join the two fields in the opponent's guard, and strike the qi flow there as the staff strikes the body.

name: Famed Radiance Block
description: Fuse the fields at each end into one resonant band and drive it through the guard, shielding the user as it passes.

name: Tipcapseal
description: Stand with the Core settled low and the staff held high, the whole body ready for a hawk's descent.

name: Steel Whitewood
description: Jab with qi from the Core pulsing through the shaft, the tip landing before the opponent has moved.

name: Paritybostip
description: Parry as lightly as a feather in a wind, turning a blow without feeling its weight.

name: Squallpivot
description: Drop in a driven step that follows the stoop, the Core's push carrying the body forward.

name: Nurturing Rightgrip
description: Circle the opponent with the staff raised, sensing weak ground with the Core's quiet field.

name: Bedrock Pivot
description: Cut down with the staff's end like a talon, qi from the Core gathering in the tip.

name: Pivot Banner
description: Hold the staff raised above the opponent and let the Core's qi weigh down the space beneath.

name: Millstone Taperend
description: Pulse the Core's qi through the staff against the opponent's weapon and hold it still.

name: Vaunted Sweepstep
description: Fall with the staff and the Core's whole push behind it, driving through the guard like a stooping hawk.

name: Entropy Leftgrip
description: Spin the staff and release the Core's qi in a broad circle, driving back all within it.

name: Pulsar Block
description: Vault high with the Core's push and cross the whole gap in an instant, striking from above.

name: Famed Tipjab
description: Stoop with the Core's full qi flowing through the staff, piercing the guard and sealing the opponent's own flow for a breath.

name: Prismbogrip
description: Stand with the staff planted before the body in the first oath, hands one over the other upon its top.

name: Haemal Roundstaff
description: Lift the staff from its planted stance in a jab, the oath's words ending as the tip lands.

name: Peal Staffcentre
description: Face the wind and turn a strike aside with the staff slanted, the gust bearing the blow away.

name: Vigorroll
description: Stride across open ground with long even paces, the staff trailing so that no step is wasted.

name: Bogrip Reliquary
description: Cross the staff to meet a strong blow and refuse to yield, as an oath is held against pressure.

name: Pivotcrown
description: Cut along the taken bearing so the stroke arrives exactly where the opponent's weight has settled.

name: Sigil Spinbreak
description: Hold the opponent's weapon on the bearing with the staff laid across it, and do not let it go.

name: Bedrock Whitewood
description: Walk into the wind with the staff held ahead, pressing the opponent back with every sworn step.

name: Pall Rightgrip
description: Turn the opponent's blow on the gust's change and strike through the opening the turn has made.

name: Sigil Taperend
description: Disrupt the pattern of an incoming technique with a single sworn rap, then strike the opening it leaves.

name: Intrepid Bostip Triumph
description: Strike on the final word of the oath so that the stroke pierces the guard and holds the weapon in place.

name: Steel Tipcap
description: Stand with the staff's tip fixed on a distant mark, the bearing taken before the first strike is thrown.

name: Tipjabtriumph
description: Jab along the taken bearing so that the tip and the mark remain in one line.

name: Deluge Bostip
description: Turn the staff a little off the bearing to parry, then return to the line unchanged.

name: Squall Leftgrip
description: Stride around the opponent so that the staff's tip never leaves its bearing, whatever the feet may do.

name: Triumphant Balancenode
description: Cut to the mark the tip has held, landing the stroke where the opponent most fears.

name: Bostippledge
description: Lay the staff on the opponent's weapon along the bearing and press steadily without wavering.

name: Thunderclap Roll
description: Drive down the taken bearing in one straight stroke that the opponent cannot turn aside.

name: Masterful Pivot
description: Wait until the opponent loses the bearing in a lunge, then strike into the confusion it causes.

name: Phantasm Bogrip
description: Hold the bearing under a heavy blow and return its weight down the staff in one piercing thrust.

name: Prismtipjab
description: Hold the bearing through every blow, then answer at the last with a thrust that guards the body as it strikes.

name: Staunch Whitewood
description: Keep the staff turning in a loose guard while the feet roam, offering the opponent no fixed point.

name: Steel Spinbreak
description: Jab from a moving step so the tip arrives with the body's drift and the wind's push together.

name: Peal Roundstaff
description: Let a blow slide past on the shaft as the gale slides round a post, without meeting its full weight.

name: Ethereal Pivot
description: Range across open ground in light paces, the staff always held between the body and the opponent.

name: Entropy Rightgrip
description: Throw the staff's tip wide as if swept by a gust, then bring it back along the other side.

name: Illustrious Balancenode
description: Chase the retreating opponent across open ground with quick taps of the tip to the hand and wrist.

name: Squalltipjab
description: Sweep the staff low in the direction the wind drives, the gust adding speed to the end's arc.

name: Tipjab Pledge
description: Wind the staff round the opponent's weapon in a loose circle and draw it across the body.

name: Millstone Block
description: Circle the opponent without a pause, the staff's tip flicking in on each pass until they tire.

name: Unbending Leftgrip
description: Strike the opponent's leading step as it lifts, so that balance fails where no wall can catch it.

name: Spinbreak Solace
description: Vanish from one position and strike from another, the staff already moving in the new place.

name: Solar Sweepstep
description: Whirl the staff in the open and loose a rush of wind-driven qi that breaks the footing of all near it.

name: Undaunted Taperend
description: Stand with the staff slanted and the breath settled, the sworn student ready to meet the first exchange.

name: Prism Staffcentre
description: Thrust straight down the sworn line, the staff driven on a single exhalation.

name: Peal Leftgrip
description: Turn the shoulder into the gale and parry with the staff held slanted, the wind adding to the turn.

name: Feather Tipjab
description: Shift windward in a single pace so the gale is at the back when the staff strikes.

name: Rolltriumph
description: Raise the staff on the gust and bring it down with the wind's full weight, landing on the shoulder.

name: Commanding Whitewood
description: Lay the staff over the opponent's weapon and hold it with the weight of the student's oath.

name: Volition Rightgrip
description: Lean the staff against the opponent's guard and press as a steady gale presses a reed.

name: Bostipdecree
description: Part the wind before the tip with a thrust that arrives whole and sharp through the guard.

name: Rollvow
description: Wait for the opponent to break their own line and strike the instant their guard opens.

name: Demolition Tipcap
description: Gather the sworn qi and release it in a rush that drives outward from the staff in every direction.

name: Vaunted Taperend Crown
description: Hold the gale's weight in the staff by oath and let it down on the opponent, pinning them where they stand.

name: Steadfast Staffcentre
description: Stand with the staff pointed on the bearing and the qi field spread wide around it like a clear sky.

name: Pivottriumph
description: Jab so that the edge of the field touches the target an instant before the tip does.

name: Sainted Tipcap
description: Parry with the field while the staff holds its bearing, so the blow turns aside before it arrives.

name: Evanescent Bostip
description: Step along the bearing with the field sensing the ground ahead, never lifting the staff off its line.

name: Steel Roll
description: Strike from the held bearing with the field behind the tip, the blow landing without any wasted motion.

name: Thralltipjab
description: Press the field against the opponent's weapon and hold it still on the bearing.

name: Quenched Sweepstep
description: Drive forward down the bearing with the field concentrated at the tip, piercing the guard.

name: Destiny Tipjab
description: Shift the field from narrow to wide and back again, striking in a new manner with each shape.

name: Bogripseal
description: Catch a great force in the field and return it along the bearing past the staff's tip.

name: Unwavering Bedrock Bogrip
description: Hold the bearing against any force and send one thrust down it that the shield of the field accompanies.

name: Resolute Roundstaff
description: Stand with the Core steady and the staff raised, the breath drawn in as if gathering a gale into the shaft.

name: Roll Banner
description: Jab on a pulse from the Core, the tip carrying the gale's first breath.

name: Pallbostip
description: Parry as the wind stalls and let the stillness hold the blow clear of the body.

name: Surging Whitewood
description: Charge with the gale at the back and the Core's push in the legs, the tip well ahead of the feet.

name: Volition Spinbreak
description: Lay the staff on the opponent's guard and let the Core's gathered wind press slowly through it.

name: Balancenode Edict
description: Cut with the staff's edge into the gale so it whistles and gathers speed through the stroke.

name: Subjugating Leftgrip
description: Wind the staff round the opponent's weapon with the gale's turn behind it and draw it round.

name: Rollsolace
description: Time a pulse of the Core to a gust and cover the ground in one step ending in a strike.

name: Splendid Bostip
description: Sweep the staff in a wide circle and send the Core's gathered gale rushing out across the ground.

name: Blockbanner
description: Bring the staff down from overhead with the Core's push and the gale's weight, splitting the high guard.

name: Season Bogrip
description: Vault across the gap on the Core's push and land with a sweep that releases the wind from the staff.

name: Imperial Staffcentre
description: Draw the gale's whole weight through the Core into the staff and bring it down in one stroke that pins as it pierces.
